releaseNotes.zh-CN:
• 模拟 Wi-Fi 在手机未连接 Wi-Fi 时仍显示已连接，延用所选虚拟网络。
• 全局模拟可纳入指定系统应用。环境列表支持输入即搜，删除环境会自动清理关联应用配置。
• 新增步行、跑步和驾车动作模拟，随路线速度调整动作频率。
• 改善启动时的设置同步和 Xposed 兼容性。
releaseNotes.en:
• Simulated Wi-Fi shows as connected even when the phone is disconnected, using the selected virtual network.
• Include selected system apps in global simulation. Filter environments as you type and clear linked app settings when deleting an environment.
• Walking, running, and driving motion profiles follow the route playback speed.
• Improve startup synchronization and Xposed compatibility.
